Add DeepSeek and guard public AI usage

Prefer DeepSeek Flash when configured and add Redis-backed rate limits for AI generation requests, including per-IP burst limits and a global daily ceiling.

Limit Avo AI chat to low-cost models

Keep only tool-capable models at or below  input and  output per million tokens, and pin that cost ceiling with a policy test.

Expose and update Avo AI

Remove the shared-secret access gate, enable feedback, restore the floating chat UI, and include the generated onboarding context. Allow Amp development portal subdomains and fix chat debug authorization.
